entities.summary: Lt. Col. Masahiko Takeshita  was the head of the domestic affairs section of the Military Affairs Bureau of the Imperial Japanese Army during World War II. In August 1945, he helped plan a coup, the Kyūjō incident, along with Major Kenji Hatanaka and a handful of others. The intent of the attempted coup d'état was to prevent the Emperor's announcement of Japan's surrender from being broadcast.
